title: Hackers Found a Way Around GitHub SHA Pinning. This Webinar Explains How to Close the Gap
content_md: Pinning GitHub Actions to an exact version of their code, known as SHA pinning, has become the go-to defense against software supply chain attacks. Attackers have already found a way around it.
